card.title: The Believer
card.subtitle: A Startup That Sold a Feeling

bubbles.text: How is this different from a normal office lease?
bubbles.speaker: left

bubbles.text: We're not selling a lease. We're selling a feeling.
bubbles.speaker: right

bubbles.text: In a fight, who wins -- the smart guy or the crazy guy?
bubbles.speaker: left

bubbles.text: Who actually owns the trademark on the word 'We'?
bubbles.speaker: left

bubbles.text: Technically? Adam does. We bought it from him.
bubbles.speaker: right

bubbles.text: What does Adam walk away with?
bubbles.speaker: left

bubbles.text: Enough that nobody calls it a firing.
bubbles.speaker: right

bubbles.text: This is the guy who just lost forty billion dollars, right?
bubbles.speaker: left

bubbles.text: And we're writing him our biggest check ever.
bubbles.speaker: right
